name: Mosquito Patch Pack Display
summary: Two-tier counter display with sixteen blank six-patch packs and one enlarged hero pack for S04.
description: Original sage counter fixture with four lanes on each of two stepped tiers. Two flat packs per lane, blank ivory cards, six generic sand-coloured round patches per card and a shallow clear formed window. One enlarged pack stands in a rear cradle. No text, logos, external assets or real product packaging.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and three shared vertex-colour materials; no external models, images, textures, fonts or brands.

display.origin: Floor centre of the base footprint; place on a counter in the mall.

accuracy_notes: Static illustrative display for S04 P2. Blank generic packs; no chemical formulation, efficacy, medical or safety claim. Shallow alpha-blended clear windows approximate PET without refraction. Stock packs deliberately overlap in depth; rear packs and lower hero patches are partly occluded. Physical Android/iOS, WebKit and complete 17-shop mall performance NOT TESTED.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry, vertex colours and three shared materials. No external assets.
